$Comment: Artillery XP for the Lantern Bombs, on a server running MMO Skill Tree. Only that mod reads this
folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A thrown bomb bursts after it leaves the hand, so by the time it lands the thrower may hold
something else, or nothing once the stack runs out. A tag: key ties the XP to the Hit tag every
blast and shard carries instead of to whatever is in hand, so every hit the burst lands trains
Artillery. The value is the per-hit XP of the per-hit combat XP mode; the damage-based modes
award by damage dealt and ignore it.
A tag: key is checked before cause: keys, so the bursts' Fire damage pays Artillery here and
never Magic's Fire row. The bombs in hand need no row: every tier's id contains Bomb, which
MMO Skill Tree's own Artillery map already covers.
Name: Hallows_Eve
